scripts.render:site: npm run audio && remotion render src/index.ts NewtonPromo ../website/public/demo/newton-promo.mp4 --crf=20 --muted
scripts.render:audio: npm run audio && remotion render src/index.ts NewtonPromo out/newton-promo-audio.mp4 --crf=20
scripts.audio:eng: npm run cues:eng && python make_audio.py out/cues-eng.json out/engineer-audio.wav
scripts.render:eng-audio: npm run audio:eng && remotion render src/index.ts EngineerFilm out/engineer-silent.mp4 --crf=22 --muted && remotion ffmpeg -y -i out/engineer-silent.mp4 -i out/engineer-audio.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 192k -shortest out/newton-engineer-audio.mp4
scripts.audio:show: npm run cues:show && python make_audio.py out/cues-show.json out/show-audio.wav
scripts.render:show-audio: npm run audio:show && remotion render src/index.ts ShowFilm out/show-silent.mp4 --crf=22 --muted && remotion ffmpeg -y -i out/show-silent.mp4 -i out/show-audio.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 192k -shortest out/newton-showcase-audio.mp4
